device_selection_info_text: Select a device model from the available options
select_device_info_text: Your device is not in the list? Add it to the <0>sensorWiki</0> to use it on the openSenseMap.
general_text: Please submit additional information about your device.
general_information_text: Provide a unique name for your device, select its operating environment (outdoor, indoor, mobile, or unknown), and add relevant tags (optional).
general_info_text: This information will be displayed publicly so be careful what you share. You can change this information later on.
exposure_explaination: This is how your device is exposed/placed.
temporary_info_text: Temporary devices will be automatically deleted after a maximum of one month.
manual_sensors_locked_text: Clear the selected schema before adding sensors manually.
sensor_mapping_conflict_description: {{sensors}} cannot be selected together because they accept the same incoming Sensor.Community value ({{valueType}}).
device_schema_upload_text: Import a JSON schema to use a fixed set of sensors for this device.
device_schema_registry_text: Search public schemas and your own private schemas, then use one as the fixed sensor set.
device_schema_invalid_file: The selected file is not a valid device schema.
sensor_selection_info_text: Select sensors for your device by choosing from predefined groups or individual sensors based on your device model. If using a custom device, configure sensors manually.
select_sensors_text: Select the sensors you want to use by clicking on the cards. You can add the same sensor multiple times.
select_sensors_info_text: Your sensor is not in the list? Add it to the <0>sensorWiki</0> to use it on the openSenseMap.
title: Title
advanced_text: Advanced connectivity settings for your device. You can only choose one option.
ttn_info_text: The openSenseMap offers an integration with <0>TheThingsNetwork</0>. Documentation for the parameters is provided on <1>GitHub</1>
mqtt_config_text: Configure your MQTT settings for data streaming
ttn_config_text: Configure your TTN (The Things Network) settings
ttn_app_id_info: The application ID recieved from TTN
ttn_dev_id_info: The device ID recieved from TTN
ttn_decode_profile_info: A decoding profile matching the payload format. For details and configuration see <0>here</0>.
ttn_decode_options_info: A JSON Array containing decoder configuration, needed for some profiles.
ttn_port_info: The TTN port to listen for messages. Optional, if not provided, all ports are used.
mqtt_info_text: The openSenseMap offers a <0>MQTT</0> client for connecting to public brokers. Documentation for the parameters is provided <1>here</1>. Please note that it's only possible to receive measurements through MQTT.
mqtt_url_info: The URL to the MQTT server.
mqtt_topic_info: The MQTT topic to subscribe to.
mqtt_message_format_info: The format the MQTT messages are in.
mqtt_decode_options_info: A json encoded string with options for decoding the message. `jsonPath` for `json`.
mqtt_connect_options_info: A json encoded string with options to supply to the MQTT client
location_info_text: Select the device's location by clicking on the map or entering latitude and longitude manually. You can optionally enter the device height above ground. An estimated surface elevation is added to calculate the device height above sea level.
location_text: Click on the map to choose a location for your device, or enter its coordinates manually.
latitude_invalid: Latitude must be a valid number.
longitude_invalid: Longitude must be a valid number.
height_above_ground_invalid: Height above ground must be a valid finite number.
height_info_label: More information about height above ground
height_info_text: Height relative to the estimated ground surface in meters. Leave blank if no device height should be stored. When available, the estimated terrain elevation is used to calculate the height above sea level.
elevation_lookup_consent: I consent to the transmission of the device coordinates to <gpxzLink>GPXZ</gpxzLink> to retrieve the height above sea level. See the <privacyLink>privacy policy</privacyLink> for details.
elevation_consent_info_label: What happens without elevation lookup consent
elevation_consent_required: Without consent, the height above ground will still be saved, but the height above sea level cannot be calculated.
elevation_unavailable: The height above sea level cannot currently be calculated. The entered height above ground will still be saved.
elevation_error: The surface elevation could not be retrieved. The entered height above ground will still be saved.
invalid_device_form: The submitted device information is invalid. Please review the form.
device_creation_failed: An unexpected error occurred while creating the device. Please try again.
integration_creation_error: Device created with an integration error
integration_creation_failed: The device was created, but the selected integration configuration could not be saved. Open the device from your profile and try saving the integration again. Affected integrations: {{integrations}}
integration_creation_failed_unknown: The device was created, but its integration configuration could not be saved. Open the device from your profile and try saving the integration again.
summary_text: Please check if everything is setup correctly.
no_integrations_available: There are currently no integrations available. Please try again later. You may add integrations from the device settings at any time after the device has been created.
